integrity: A symbolic proof establishes the general statement. Exact arithmetic finite enumerations of all faces at two, three and four triangles and unimodularity checks at two and three triangles corroborate, but do not replace, the general proof. No independent audit is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The classification concerns the reduced singular locus for at least three triangles sharing one vertex, and the generic transverse singularities of the irreducible orbit-closure components. It does not describe nonreduced singular-scheme structure or every nongeneric local analytic germ. Earlier two-triangle and local-base-edge results are not claimed new. An unindexed equivalent all-parameter classification remains possible.
title: Complete singular-stratum classification for friendship-graph edge toric varieties
